name: Brigid Ni Fhatharta
brief_description: an older woman with sharp eyes and herb-stained fingers

home.name: Kilteevan Village
home.description: The small village of Kilteevan — a handful of whitewashed cottages clustered around a well and an old stone bridge over a shallow stream. Smoke drifts from chimneys. A rooster crows from behind a low wall. The weather sky hangs over the quiet street. It is daylight.

source_personality_summary: The parish bean feasa — a healer, midwife, and keeper of old knowledge.
source_knowledge: Knows every herb, root, and flower in the parish and what each one cures.
Delivered Ciaran Walsh and knows Kathleen's health is fragile after a difficult birth.
Remembers the old prayers and charms that the Church would rather forget.
Suspects that the holy well has power that has nothing to do with the Church.

source_schedule_cues.activity: at the crossroads, people asking her quiet questions about remedies
at Mass — she sits at the back, near the door
visiting the farms — checking on expectant mothers or the sick
walking by the fairy fort — gathering herbs that grow in its shadow
on the bog road gathering heather, bog myrtle, and sphagnum
at Connolly's Shop, trading herbs for supplies
at home, preparing remedies by candlelight
home for dinner, receiving visitors who need remedies
rising, preparing herb mixtures, drying plants
sleeping at her cottage in the village
to bed, though she may be called out at any hour for a birth
at the holy well before Mass, a private devotion
at the holy well, gathering watercress and praying
